name: runzero-mcp
description: Every runZero query, plus a local SQLite copy of your whole attack surface that diffs over time, joins assets to vulnerabilities offline, and costs zero API quota to re-slice.

runzero_api_key.title: RUNZERO_API_KEY
runzero_api_key.description: Sets RUNZERO_API_KEY for the runZero MCP server.

runzero_base_url.title: runZero API base URL
runzero_base_url.description: Base URL for the runZero API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

runzero_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
runzero_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on runZero requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

runzero_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
runzero_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any non-GET execute call. Leave blank to keep every tool (a tool that changes runZero data still sends only with confirm: true).

runzero_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
runzero_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API, the response cache is off, and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

runzero_mcp_upload_root.title: MCP upload folder (optional)
runzero_mcp_upload_root.description: Optional. Leave blank: an MCP upload (the scan, Nessus and packet imports) then takes the file's content base64-encoded. Set it to a directory to let MCP callers name a file inside that directory instead; a path outside it is refused.

runzero_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
runzero_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.
